name: 044_tv_chartart_rsi_bb_tf3
hypothesis: TradingView port (owner request): 'Bollinger + RSI, Double Strategy (by ChartArt) v1.1'. The author's claim: when price crosses back inside a 200-bar Bollinger band (2 sd) on the same bar as RSI(6) crosses 50 in the same direction, both indicators agree that an overextension is over, so the move reverts - long when close crosses up through the lower band while RSI(6) crosses above 50, short when close crosses down through the upper band while RSI(6) crosses below 50. Counterparty: late breakout traders caught outside the band. Author parameters are kept exactly (RSI 6, levels 50/50, BB 200 x 2.0, close). DEVIATIONS from the Pine script, which the engine forces: (1) the original has no stop and no exit - it only reverses on the opposite signal - and the engine has no stop-and-reverse and every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop and a time stop are added and are the only grid keys; (2) the original enters with a stop order at the band, which the price has already crossed, so it fills at the next bar's open - the same as the engine's taker entry; (3) TradingView's default commission is 0, here it is 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. The source chart is 4h; variants use chart mode (the same bar counts on every chart, as a TradingView user would apply it). [Timeframe variant of 044_tv_chartart_rsi_bb, 240m -> 3m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x0.0125, pct stop x0.112.]
